functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_memclr/__aeabi_memclr4: movs r2,#0 then tail into the memset store loop at 0x100044C6 (word/halfword/byte zero fill).

immediates.meaning: Fill byte/word is always zero (memclr vs memset)
lsls remaining<<30 tests bit 1 for halfword store

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_uidivmod: restoring unsigned 32-bit divide. Returns CONCAT44(remainder, quotient) = r1:r0. Falls into the shared bit engine used by signed divide.

immediates.meaning: Normalize divisor by <<8/<<16 when dividend>>16 >= divisor; quotient seed -0x1000000/-0x10000

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_idivmod: signed 32-bit divide/mod. If both nonnegative, uses the unsigned engine; else take abs, divide, restore quotient/remainder signs.

immediates.meaning: orrs then bmi: either operand negative -> signed path at 0x10004628
Nonneg path starts at dividend>>1 vs divisor
asrs >>31 extracts operand signs before abs

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_d2f: IEEE-754 double (r0 lo, r1 hi) to float. Exponent rebias +0xC8000000 (127-1023 = -896 << 20), Inf 0x7F800000, qNaN DAT_1000476C=0x7FC00000.

immediates.meaning: Extract double sign bit from high word
Packed float Inf when rebiased exp overflows

functions.purpose: Same-sign IEEE-754 double add kernel: compare magnitudes, align by exp delta (>>20), add 53-bit mantissa, round/normalize. Overflow uses DAT Inf 0x7FF00000 / signed Inf 0xFFF00000; NaN 0x7FF80000.

immediates.meaning: Extract 11-bit double exponent from high word
Overflow test on (hi<<1) vs max finite

functions.purpose: IEEE-754 double subtract kernel: if |a|<|b| swap and XOR sign, align negated subtrahend, subtract, CLZ-normalize denormals. Shared by dadd/dsub/drsub.

immediates.meaning: XOR sign when swapping operands so result sign follows larger magnitude

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_dadd: if signs differ, XOR 0x80000000 onto b and call subtract kernel; else add kernel.

immediates.meaning: Negate b (flip sign bit) before magnitude subtract when signs differ

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_dsub (a-b): if signs differ, negate b and add magnitudes; else subtract magnitudes.

immediates.meaning: Negate b before add kernel when signs already differ

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_drsub: always XOR sign of a then dadd, computing b-a.

immediates.meaning: Negate minuend a so the rest is ordinary dadd of (-a)+b

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_ddiv: 8-bit reciprocal table (DAT_10004AB4+DAT_10004EB4), Newton refine, 16-bit mantissa fragments, Inf/NaN via 0x7FF00000/0x7FF80000. Exp packed as >>4 & 0x07FF0000.

immediates.meaning: Byte reciprocal table offset from DAT_10004AB4
Combined bias adjust on packed exponents

functions.purpose: ARM reverse double divide (_drdiv): swap operand pairs then DivideDoubleSoftFloat. No in-image callers.
ARM EABI __aeabi_d2iz: unpack mantissa (lo>>21 | hi<<11), shift DAT_10004F74(0x41E)-exp, negate if signed; overflow ~sign ^ 0x80000000 (INT_MAX/INT_MIN).

immediates.meaning: 1023+31 = double bias + int width for shift count
Hidden mantissa MSB / INT_MIN overflow payload

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_d2uiz: unsigned double->uint. Force hidden 1 at bit 31, shift 0x41E-exp; out-of-range yields 0 or ~sign.

immediates.meaning: Insert hidden mantissa bit for normals

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_i2d: extract sign, abs, binary-normalize (16/8/4/2/1), pack exp as nBitIndex*0x100000 + (sign|0x40000000). Tail-calls unsigned pack loop at 0x10004FC4 (__aeabi_ui2d).

immediates.meaning: lsrs r0,#31 then lsl #31 isolates sign
Double exponent bias seed (~1024<<20) ORed with sign
Shared ui2d CLZ start bit index 31

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_dmul: split 53-bit mantissas into 14-bit fragments, Karatsuba-style cross products, exp sum minus 0x3FC0000. Specials: Inf DAT_1000525C=0x7FF00000, NaN 0x7FF80000.

immediates.meaning: Subtract combined double biases from packed exp sum
NaN high word for inf*0 / NaN inputs

functions.purpose: ARM ldexp / __aeabi_ldexp: result = value * 2^n by adding n*0x100000 to the exponent field. Zero/Inf/overflow/underflow via DAT 0x7FF / Inf / qNaN.

immediates.meaning: Max double exponent; XOR detects Inf
NaN when scaling Inf with nonzero mantissa

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_f2d: float bits to double. Normal: hi = (float>>3)+/-0x38000000 (bias 1023-127), lo = float<<29. Subnormals/NaN/Inf special-cased (NaN DAT_10005314=0x7FF80000).

immediates.meaning: Quiet double NaN for float NaN

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_fdiv: exp as >>7 & 0xFF0000, 8-bit reciprocal table at DAT_10005470, Newton, pack Inf 0x7F800000/0xFF800000, qNaN DAT_10005474=0x7FC00000.

immediates.meaning: Float bias pair 127+126 packed into exp difference

functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_f2iz: mantissa<<8 | hidden 1, shift 0x9E-exp (127+31). Overflow ~sign ^ 0x80000000.
ARM EABI __aeabi_f2uiz: same unpack as f2iz without signed negate; too-large/NaN -> 0, negative overflow -> ~sign.

immediates.meaning: Upper bound for finite float<<1 before returning ~sign
